Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the run chase. The Zimbabwe players make their way out to the field. Aaron Finch and David Warner will open the innings and will look to get their team to the finish line without any hiccups. Richard Ngarava will begin proceedings with the new ball.
... RUN CHASE ...

Right then, the target of 97 should not trouble the Australian batters and with the batting lineup they have, we should be seeing a quick chase. Zimbabwe will know that they have very little chance to clinch victory but they will need to come out with intent and look to take early wickets. We would assume that Australia will take an assailable lead and win the series but who can ever tell what magic cricket could provide? Stay tuned as we will be back shortly for the run chase.

Zimbabwe would have loved to bowl first as well and exploit the conditions early but they would be even more disappointed by the fact that none of the batters showed any sort of application at the wicket. After losing wickets early, they decided to attack the Australian bowlers but that ploy did not work as more wickets fell. Sean Williams on his return to the team showed some sort of fight scoring 29 runs and spending time at the wicket. None of the others added any meaningful contributions, especially Sikandar Raza and Regis Chakabva who got off to starts but could not make the most of it. They could not cross the 100-run mark and have left their bowlers with an uphill task to climb.

This was a good toss to win for Australia as they chose to bowl with no hesitation. Mitchell Starc had the ball nipping around and took three wickets early to put Zimbabwe on the back foot straight away. He handed over the baton to the other bowlers who came on and took wickets almost immediately. Cameron Green continued his good form taking 2 wickets in the 3 overs he bowled and Adam Zampa once again got three scalps against his name. Josh Hazlewood and Ashton Agar chipped in with one each to contribute to what was a complete bowling performance. The bowlers can now stretch their legs and watch the batters complete the task at hand which should not be difficult at all.

This had been an absolute demolition of the visiting side! Australia have bowled their opponents out for 96 runs and in under 28 overs. Zimbabwe did not have a glimmer of hope as the host came out all guns blazing and kept picking wickets at regular intervals. The Aussies will look to come out and knock over these runs in no time and nothing short of a miracle could result in a Zimbabwe win.

OUT! LBW! Zampa wraps things up! This is very full and pushed through quicker, around off, was a googly as well. Evans fails to read as he has a wild swing across the line but misses and gets hit on the back pad. A huge shout for LBW and up goes the finger. Evans is quick to review as he thinks there is some bat on it. UltraEdge is taking time to load. The umpire tries to work with slow-motion replays. No bat, calls the third umpire as confirmed by Hotspot. Ball Tracking shows umpire's call on wickets hitting. Zimbabwe are all out on 96.
Tossed up, outside off. Ngarava hits it to deep cover for a single.
Full and on middle, pushed to covers.
Richard Ngarava is the last batter to make his way out to the crease.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! A quicker ball from Zampa, shorter and angling around leg as it skids through off the surface. Jongwe tries to use the depth of his crease as he looks to push it away but he misses and the ball hits his pads before hitting the leg stump. Luke Jongwe has to depart and getting to 100 is looking hard for Zimbabwe. Adam Zampa continues his fine form with the ball.
Outside off, cut to deep point for a single.
Short in length and outside off. Evans throws his bat at it and the ball flies over the man at point for a singe.
On middle. Kept out.
This is full and outside off, it is pushed to the left of Green who stretches his long hand to collect.
On a length and around off. Defended out to cover.
Brad Evans is the new batter at the crease.

OUT! EDGED AND GONE! Green with his second wicket! A bouncer, around off and it gets big on Burl who gets on his toes to defend but the ball brushes his glove and goes to the keeper, Alex Carey who gobbles it up. Just superb stuff from Green. Australia are all over their opponents here and Zimbabwe have been pegged against the wall.
Commentary.Howout: c Alex Carey b Cameron Green

Commentary.Commentary: On middle. Burl sits under it.
Starc with an effort ball! On a length and slanting on middle. Jongwe defends with the higher part of the blade.
Length ball, outside off. Burl guides it wide of point for one more.
FOUR! Crucial runs! Pitched up, outside off. Burl drives it firmly through covers for a boundary.
On middle, pushed to mid on.
Very full and angling down the leg side. Burl misses his flick and gets hit on the pads. An appeal for LBW but it was going down.

Dropped! That was hit hard but only Maxwell can take those type of catches! A length ball, outside off. Jongwe cuts it hard and to the left of point. Glenn Maxwell tries to take it there but fails to hang onto it.
Short in length, around off and extra bounce there. Burl looks to push but gets hit near his gloves.
FOUR! Burl with a lovely shot! On a length and outside off. Burl drives it on the up but is perfectly placed to the left of mid off for a boundary.
Outside off, left alone.
Short of a length and outside off. Burl looks to push it away but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Short in length and outside off. Burl keeps it out.
A bouncer on middle. Burl sits under it.
Luke Jongwe is out in the middle.

OUT! TAKEN! Sean Williams' stay is cut short as Zampa provides the breakthrough. The set-batter goes now and we are into the tail-enders! Sean Williams will be disappointed with this shot. Pitched up, outside off, a bit of air given by Zampa. Williams tries to go over covers but his foot is stuck in his crease and the ball generates a thick outside edge and goes to short third man where Cameron Green runs to his right and pouches it in front of him.
Commentary.Howout: c Cameron Green b Adam Zampa

Commentary.Commentary: Drops a bit short on middle, pulled away to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
A low full toss on middle. Williams looks to sweep but gets an inside edge onto the pads. Should have put away that.
Very full and on middle, quicker as well. Williams jams it out back to the bowler.
Zampa serves a googly, full and outside off. Burl dabs it to third man for a single.
A full toss on leg. Williams reverse sweeps it to deep point for a single.
A slower length ball on middle. Burl wrists it to mid-wicket.
On the pads, it is flicked to mid-wicket.
Full and on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Ryan Burl is the new batter out in the middle.

OUT! EDGED AND GONE! Green with his first wicket in his very first over! He is certainly enjoying this tour! He shows why he is so crucial in these middle overs! Serves a short ball, around off, the ball just nips away off the deck. Tony Munyonga is squared up as he looks to defend and gets an outside edge to the keeper, Alex Carey who makes no mistake.
Commentary.Howout: c Alex Carey b Cameron Green

Commentary.Commentary: Length and outside off. Williams steers it to backward point. A bit of misfield from Maxwell and the batters take a quick single Maxwell is quick to collect the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Again it was very close.
The hero from the last match starts with a full ball on middle, flicked to deep mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Second of the over! Another stand which looks promising for the visitors! Fuller and outside off. Williams heaves it to deep mid-wicket for four.
Way outside off, fuller and Tony Munyonga works it to cover for one.
Flatter and outside off. Williams dabs it to short third man for a single.
Outside off, cut through point for a single.
FOUR! A loopy ball, full and outside off. Tony Munyonga stays back and slams it over mid off for four.
Tossed up, around off. Blocked on the front foot.
Nails the yorker this time on middle. Williams jams it out to mid on.
Wide! Tries a yorker but pushes it down the leg side. Williams misses his flick.
Extra bounce this time! Good stuff from Starc! Shorter and outside off. Williams tries to defend inside the line and misses.
Around off on a length. Williams guides it to point.
On a length and outside off. Williams punches it to mid off.
Way outside off. Williams lets it go.

EDGED AWAY! Short in length and outside off. Tony Munyonga is hurried as he looks to defend and gets a thick outside edge over first slip for a single. Steven Smith thought he had a chance but the ball was way over him. He slipped as he was trying to run back. Starc has a laugh at it.
Zampa pushes it quicker, shorter and outside off. Tony Munyonga looks to pull but gets a bottom edge and hits his pads. It rolls away for one.
On the pads, whipped to deep square leg for one.
Very full and on off, played back to the bowler.
A googly, full and around off. Williams kneels as he looks to sweep but gets hit high on the pads.
Around off, pushed through covers for a single.
Zampa starts with a flatter ball on the pads, it is flicked to deep square leg for a single.
Outside off. Left alone for the third dot.
Fuller and again outside off. Tony Munyonga shoulders arms.
Way outside off, left alone.
BEAUTY! An off-cutter, length and just outside off. Tony Munyonga is squared up as he looks to defend and gets beaten on the outside edge,
On the hips, bunted to square leg.
A direct hit would have had him! A whisker away! Around off, Williams punches it to covers and takes a quick single. Warner has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Tossed up, angling on middle. Blocked back on the deck.
Tony Munyonga walks out to the middle.

OUT! TAKEN! The skipper goes now! The promising start is over and Zimbabwe have lost half their team! A floated full ball, outside off. Regis Chakabva was not in control as he tries to go over covers. He toe ends his shot and Mitchell Starc backtracks to hold onto it. This has been a disppointing display as the batters seem to be throwing their wickets away on a difficult pitch.
Commentary.Howout: c Mitchell Starc b Ashton Agar

Commentary.Commentary: Angling on the pads, slower and Regis Chakabva misses his flick to get hit on the pads.
FOUR! Second boundary for the captain! A loopy ball, outside off. Regis Chakabva thumps it back over Agar who tries to take it with both hands but that was hit with venom.
Too full and on middle. Defended.
Tossed up, outside off, spinning in. Williams turns it through mid-wicket for one.
Short of a length and on middle. Richard Ngarava bunts it to square leg.
Length ball, just around off, pushed to point.
This is on top of off, it is nudged to square leg.
FOUR! Welcome boundary! This is aggression from the skipper! Fuller and outside off. Regis Chakabva comes down the track and smashes it past mid off for a boundary.
On a length and around off, rises a bit more than expected. Regis Chakabva again blocks it.
Fuller ball, around off, Regis Chakabva works it to mid-wicket.
Around off, Regis Chakabva drops it wide of point for a quick single.
Tossed up, wide of off. Williams drives it past the diving cover fielder for one.
This is full and outside off. Regis Chakabva drives it on the up, through point for a single.
Tossed up, slower and around off. Regis Chakabva leans and blocks it.
Fuller ball, around off, eased down to long on for a single.
Tossed up on off. Sean Williams blocks it out.
Josh Hazlewood bowls this on a good length and in line with the stumps, Regis Chakabva blocks the ball back down the pitch.

Drinks! The wicket of Raza has bought Australia back on top. They bossed the start but Raza just started to shift the momentum a bit. Zimbabwe have been miserable since then. They'll just hope for one good stand that could help them release some pressure. It is tough going for them. Also, Regis Chakabva is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Josh Hazlewood gets his man and Sikandar Raza's counter punch has to end here! Josh Hazlewood bangs this one short and bowls this well outside off, Sikandar Raza goes across the stumps and looks to pull this towards the leg side. Stumbles as he is taking a shot and gets a top edge that flies towards deep square leg. Marcus Stoinis is standing in position as he settles low to take the catch and rolls onto his back. Big wicket for Australia as the danger man Sikandar Raza departs. Zimbabwe are now four down and are looking down a barrel.
Commentary.Howout: c Marcus Stoinis b Josh Hazlewood

Commentary.Commentary: Josh Hazlewood bowls this on a good length and outside off, Sikandar Raza is not interested in playing at this one.

SIX! Sikandar Raza looking to take the attack to Australia! Josh Hazlewood goes full and outside the off pole, Sikandar Raza gets a stride forward and lifts the ball over the infield on the off side. The ball flies over the deep cover boundary and Zimbabwe are finally getting a move on.

FOUR! Connects this one well enough! Josh Hazlewood bangs this in short and outside the off stump, Sikandar Raza rocks back and pulls this towards the deep mid-wicket fence. The ball lands just in front of the ropes and gets Sikandar Raza four runs.
Josh Hazlewood serves this on a good length and outside off, Sikandar Raza shimmies down the wicket and looks to heave this. Does not connect as the ball goes through to the keeper.
This is full as well and spinning into the batter, Sean Williams tucks this towards mid-wicket.
Flights this on full and just outside off, Sean Williams defends this back towards the bowler.
Ashton Agar is a bit short this time and outside off, Sikandar Raza slaps this to deep cover for a single.
Goes full once again and straight, Sean Williams knocks the ball to long on for a run.
This is full and in line with the stumps, Sean Williams blocks this back down the pitch towards the bowler.
FOUR! Zimbabwe finally get one away to the fence! Ashton Agar flights this one full and outside off, Sean Williams sweeps this well and finds the deep square leg boundary for four runs.
Josh Hazlewood goes short and outside off, Sikandar Raza mistimes his pull just over mid-wicket and gets a couple of runs.
Beaten! Josh Hazlewood persists with a good length delivery outside off, Sikandar Raza pushes at this and gets beaten all ends up.
This is on a good length outside off, Sikandar Raza goes back in the crease and blocks the ball towards cover-point.
Continues bowling on a good length and outside the off stump, Sikandar Raza leaves this one alone.
This is on a good length and outside off, Sikandar Raza goes for an expansive drive and gets beaten on the outside edge.

Josh Hazlewood cuts the batter into half! Bowls this on a good length and gets the ball to nip back in sharply. Sikandar Raza plays along the line but gets beaten on the inside edge. Alex Carey dives to his left and collects well and there is an appeal but the umpire remains unmoved.
This one is a touch fuller and on middle, Sikandar Raza clips this towards deep square leg and takes a single to retain strike.
Marcus Stoinis bowls this on a good length and in line with the stumps, Sikandar Raza defends this back towards the bowler.
This is on a good length and angling in, Sikandar Raza blocks the ball towards mid-wicket.
This is on a good length and just outside the off pole, Sikandar Raza stands tall and blocks the ball back into the pitch. Dances around to make sure the ball does not roll back onto the stumps.
This one is short and wide outside off, Sean Williams slashes hard at the ball but will only get the single as the fine leg fielder comes across to cut it off.
Marcus Stoinis serves this one on a good length and outside the off pole, Sean Williams taps the ball towards short cover.
Gets the ball to nip back in sharply from a good length, Sikandar Raza gets beaten on the inside edge and gets hit on the pads. Just one run from this over. Australia keeping it really tight.
Goes back to bowling on a good length and in line with the stumps, Sikandar Raza gets a leading edge back down the pitch towards the bowler.
Josh Hazlewood goes a touch fuller and outside off, Sikandar Raza knocks the ball towards cover.
This is outside off as well on a good length, Sikandar Raza is happy to lets this go through to the keeper.
This one is one a good length as well and outside the off stump, Sikandar Raza raises his arms and leaves this alone.
Josh Hazlewood serves this on a good length and in line with the stumps, Sean Williams clips the ball towards square leg for a single.
Powerplay 2! Now four fielders are allowed outside the inner circle till the 40th over.
Continues bowling on a good length and outside off, Sikandar Raza leaves this one alone. Just one run from the over.
Marcus Stoinis bowls an off-cutter on a good length and just outside off, Sikandar Raza comes forward to defend but gets beaten by the ball nipping back in. Gets hit high on the pads.
This one is on a good length as well and pitching on middle, Sikandar Raza taps this towards mid-wicket.
Marcus Stoinis bowls this on a good length and outside the off pole, Sikandar Raza blocks this solidly back down the pitch.
Pulls his length back a fraction and on an off stump line. There is some extra bounce as Sean Williams gets on top of this and works it past backward point for a run.
Marcus Stoinis bowls this slightly full and pitching on an off stump line, Sean Williams taps the ball towards mid off.
This is full and outside the off pole, Sikandar Raza knocks the ball towards the cover fielder.
Mitchell Starc goes short this time and straight, Sikandar Raza fends this towards backward square leg.
Goes for a yorker in line with the stumps, Sean Williams gets his bat down in time and the ball takes the inside edge towards fine leg for a single.
Mitchell Starc serves this on a good length and outside off, Sean Williams taps this down to gully.
WIDE! Bangs this in short and angling down leg, Sean Williams goes for the pull but is far from the ball. The umpire indicates that this is wide.
This is a touch fuller and in line with the stumps, Sean Williams clips this towards square leg.
Mitchell Starc begins the over with a good length delivery shaping away from the left-hander. Sean Williams does not get his bat too close to the ball and lets it through.
Bowls this one full and in line with the stumps, Sikandar Raza clips the ball towards deep square leg and takes a couple of runs.
Marcus Stoinis bowls this a fraction short and outside off, Sikandar Raza cuts this straight to the point fielder.
On a good length once again and outside off, Sikandar Raza shoulders his arms to this one as well.
This one is close to the off pole on a good length, Sikandar Raza judges this well and leaves it alone.
This is on a good length and just outside off, Sikandar Raza blocks the ball towards mid-wicket.
Marcus Stoinis begins with a really full delivery outside off, Sikandar Raza digs the ball out towards point.

FOUR! First boundary for Zimbabwe! Mitchell Starc bowls this a bit full and outside off, Sean Williams gets a stride forward and strokes the ball towards deep cover for a much-needed boundary! That should release a bit of pressure.
WIDE! Full and straying down leg, Sean Williams looks to flick this fine but misses. The umpire indicates that this is wide.
Goes full once again but strays onto the pads, Sikandar Raza clips this towards fine leg and take a single to get off the mark.
Mitchell Starc serves this one full and outside off as well, Sikandar Raza is happy to let this go to keeper.
This is on a good length and outside off, Sikandar Raza leaves this one alone.
What a delivery first up to Sikandar Raza! Mitchell Starc bowls this on a good length and gets the ball to move away slightly. Sikandar Raza tries to defend but gets beaten all ends up.
Sikandar Raza makes his way out to the crease with his team in a spot of bother.

OUT! CAUGHT! Mitchell Starc is running through Zimbabwe's top order here! Tadiwanashe Marumani is the next casualty as Zimbabwe find themselves in deep trouble. Mitchell Starc serves this full and in line with the stumps, Tadiwanashe Marumani flicks the ball straight into the hands of square leg. Marnus Labuschagne (sub) does not make any mistake as he pouches an easy catch. Zimbabwe have lost their third.
Commentary.Howout: c sub Marnus Labuschagne b Mitchell Starc

Commentary.Commentary: Goes back to bowling on a good length and outside off, Sean Williams taps the ball towards mid off. Another maiden for Josh Hazlewood. Australia are building the pressure.
Pulls his length back a fraction, and bowls this outside the off stump, Sean Williams slashes this straight to point.
This is a touch fuller and in line with the stumps, Sean Williams clips this towards mid-wicket.
What a delivery! Josh Hazlewood continues probing outside off on a good length. Sean Williams is unable to play this as it swishes past his outside edge.
On a good length once again and outside off, Sean Williams feels for the ball and gets beaten all ends up.
This is on a good length and outside off, Sean Williams blocks this solidly towards cover.

Beaten! Mitchell Starc gets this close to the off stump on a good length, Tadiwanashe Marumani pushes at the ball and gets beaten. End of another successful over from Mitchell Starc with just a run coming from it.
This is full and in line with the stumps, Sean Williams looks to flick this leg side but gets a leading edge towards cover for a single.
Mitchell Starc bowls this on a good length and outside off, Sean Williams lets this one go through to the keeper.
Sean Williams strides out to the middle and Zimbabwe will be hoping he can get going.

OUT! LBW! Mitchell Starc strikes again and it's the in-form player Wesley Madhevere! Mitchell Starc goes full and gets the ball to swing in from middle, Wesley Madhevere plays at it late and the ball crashes into the pads. There is a huge appeal and the umpire takes his time but eventually gives that out. They consider reviewing this but will not take it and Wesley Madhevere makes the long walk back to the pavillion. Zimbabwe have lost their second wicket.
This one is wider outside off and on a good length, Wesley Madhevere leaves this one alone as well.
Mitchell Starc bowls this on a good length and goes away from the right-hander. Wesley Madhevere shoulders arms to this one.
Bowls this on a good length and closer to the off pole, Tadiwanashe Marumani is happy to leave this one alone. Back-to-back maidens for Australia.
Josh Hazlewood goes back to bowling on a good length and outside off, Tadiwanashe Marumani pokes at this and gets beaten once again.
This one is a fraction full and in line with the stumps, Tadiwanashe Marumani clips this towards mid-wicket, and Marcus Stoinis does well to dive and stop the ball.
Josh Hazlewood serves this on a good length and outside the off stump, Tadiwanashe Marumani goes for an expansive drive and gets beaten on the outside edge.
This one is back of a length as well, and outside off, Tadiwanashe Marumani feels for the ball and gets beaten.
Josh Hazlewood bowls this back of a length and in line with the stumps, Tadiwanashe Marumani blocks this down the pitch awkwardly.
Wesley Madhevere makes his way out to the middle. He will be looking to continue his good form.

OUT! TIMBER! Mitchell Starc draws first blood! Mitchell Starc goes full and just outside off, gets the ball to nip back in sharply. Finds the gap between bat and pad to clip the off stump as Innocent Kaia was looking to defend this. Innocent Kaia has to depart and Australia have an early break through. Mitchell Starc has bowled a wicket-maiden and the pressure is now on Zimbabwe.
Decides to bowl on a good length and outside off, Innocent Kaia stands tall and blocks it towards cover.
Attempts a yorker but bowls a full toss outside off, Innocent Kaia taps the ball towards cover-point.
Goes full once again and outside off, Innocent Kaia knocks this straight to the point fielder.
This is a touch fuller and in line with the stumps, Innocent Kaia clips this towards square leg.
Mitchell Starc bowls this on a good length and angles it away from the right-hander. Innocent Kaia goes for the drive but can not connect.
Josh Hazlewood goes back to bowling on a good length and outside off, Tadiwanashe Marumani pushes at this and gets a thick outside edge past the second slip fielder for a couple of runs to fine leg.
What a jaffa! Slightly back of a length and outside the off stump, Tadiwanashe Marumani feels for this and gets beaten all ends up.
FOUR LEG BYES! Straying onto the pads on a fuller length, Tadiwanashe Marumani gets pad on this as it runs away to fine leg for four leg byes.
Continues bowling on a good length and angling away from the left-hander. Tadiwanashe Marumani slashes at this but gets beaten as the ball is too close to cut.
On a good length and outside the off stump, Tadiwanashe Marumani blocks this towards cover.
Josh Hazlewood begins with a good length delivery just outside off, Innocent Kaia looks to block and gets a thick outside edge to third man for a single.
Josh Hazlewood will bowl from the other end.
Goes full once again and angles the ball into the pads, Tadiwanashe Marumani clips this towards deep square leg and takes a couple of runs.
This is a touch full and outside off, Tadiwanashe Marumani mistimes his shot towards covers.
This is a fraction short and outside the off pole. Tadiwanashe Marumani looks to cut this square but gets beaten by the bounce.
WIDE! This is down leg side as well. The umpire indicates wide for the third time in this over.
What a beauty! Bowls this on a good length and just outside off, Tadiwanashe Marumani feels for it and gets beaten all ends up.
WIDE! Straying down leg this time on a fuller length. The umpire calls this wide as well.
Mitchell Starc serves this full and angling down leg, Tadiwanashe Marumani looks to flick this but misses and gets hit on the pads. There is a stifled appeal.
Goes full this time in line with the stumps, Innocent Kaia clips this to deep backward square leg and gets off the mark with a single.
WIDE! Mitchell Starc begins with a delivery served well outside off stump on a fuller length. This has been called wide by the umpire.

We are all set for the game. The players make their way out to the middle. Innocent Kaia and Tadiwanashe Marumani are the openers for Zimbabwe and will be looking to get their team off to a good start. Mitchell Starc will begin proceedings with the new ball.

Australia (Playing XI) - Aaron Finch (C), David Warner, Steven Smith, Alex Carey (WK), Marcus Stoinis, Cameron Green, Glenn Maxwell, Ashton Agar (In place of Mitchell Marsh), Mitchell Starc, Adam Zampa, Josh Hazlewood.

Zimbabwe (Playing XI) - Innocent Kaia, Tadiwanashe Marumani, Wesley Madhevere, Tony Munyonga, Sean Williams (In place of Victor Nyauchi), Sikandar Raza, Regis Chakabva (C & WK), Ryan Burl, Luke Jongwe, Brad Evans, Richard Ngarava.
TOSS - The coin is flipped into the air and lands in favor of Australia. They have elected to BOWL first once again.

Australia have loaded their team with big-hitting all-rounders but have lost Mitchell Marsh to an injury. In the first encounter, Cameron Green took his maiden five-wicket haul and Glenn Maxwell did what Glenn Maxwell does best to take Australia to the finish line. The two vital players that stand in the way of the visitors are Australia’s stalwarts, David Warner and Steven Smith. With Adam Zampa ripping through the top order, Australia may consider going in with another spinner although that looks unlikely. They will not take this Zimbabwe side lightly and will be hoping to put up a professional performance and seal the series. Can they take an unassailable lead? We will find out soon. Stay tuned for the toss and other updates.

The visitors put on a steady batting performance to begin the innings after losing the toss and being asked to bat first. In recent times the middle order has been winning games for this side with Sikandar Raza leading the charge. In the first game, there was a mini collapse as they lost their last six wickets for 15 runs. The side will be bolstered by the return of their experienced all-rounder Sean Williams. They will be hoping to learn from their mistakes and play out the full quota of overs. The bowlers caused some problems but did not have enough on the board to defend. They will need a complete team performance here if they are to beat their more fancied opponents.
